description: Multi-agent orchestrator for homeowners insurance claims triage. Decomposes each claim into a coverage/exclusions sub-task and an adjuster-note summarisation sub-task, then synthesises a final coverage decision and payout.

skills.name: Coverage & Exclusions Decision
skills.description: Determines COVERED/DENIED/PARTIALLY_COVERED for a claim by checking policy exclusions.

skills.name: Adjuster Note Summarisation
skills.description: Extracts structured cause-of-loss summary from adjuster notes.

skills.name: Payout Computation
skills.description: Computes net payable amount after policy excess deduction.
